title: My Little Kite
stanzas: I have a kite of red and blue,
It flies up high the whole day through.
It dances with the morning breeze,
Above the roofs and tall green trees.

title: The Rain Song
stanzas: On the roof and window pane.
Frogs are happy, ducks can play,
The rain has come to stay today.

title: Ravi and the Mango Tree
stanzas: Ravi has a mango tree in his garden.
Every summer the tree is full of sweet mangoes.
Ravi shares the mangoes with his friends.
They sit under the tree and laugh together.

title: The Busy Ant
stanzas: A small ant walked across the floor.
It carried a grain of rice on its back.
The rice was bigger than the ant.
But the ant did not give up.
It walked slowly and reached its home.
